max_reasoning: REASONING-1 NF525 chain bit-identical extension: every payment serialised one or more audit_log rows whose current_hash = SHA256(prev_hash || payload). Baseline 96 -> +3 (POS) -> +2 (Kiosk) -> 101 final. Last_hash advances strictly monotonically from 0938b918... to 14d8f790... without gap. No manual writes performed during cycle (DM6 RO discipline). This proves the application code path (PaymentService + KioskPaymentService) is the SOLE producer of audit entries.

REASONING-2 SSOT write fan-out per payment: 1 click on Confirmer produces 5-6 SSOT writes in deterministic order: (1) orders row insert with fiscal_sequence_no allocated under Cache::lock+FOR UPDATE, (2) order_items rows, (3) audit_logs HMAC chain entry, (4) domain_events dispatched to private-branch.{branchId} channel, (5) cash_movements drawer increment, (6) order_status_transitions row. All within sub-second persist window. Confirms PaymentService internal transaction discipline.

REASONING-3 Sync mode taxonomy observed: (a) DB-pull-on-navigation (OSS) — works instantly, query fresh on Blade render; (b) Server-rendered-cached-once (POS borne panel, KDS Blade DOM) — stale immediately after any backend change without forced reload; (c) WebSocket-push-only (KDS Vue board) — depends on Echo+Pusher broker; if broker degraded, NO update. The 3 P1 sync findings cluster under (b) and (c). FIX HIERARCHY: enable (a)-style fallback re-query on tab focus + N-sec polling for critical panels, before adding more push.

REASONING-4 Fiscal safety vs UX trade-off: SealedOrderGuard correctly prevents pre-Z post-Z double-refund pattern. Without this guard, cashier could refund order #111 in current Z window via mirror, then also flip parent.status->RETURNED via OrderStateMachine → 2 negatives for 1 sale ledger violation. Guard is invariant, well-placed at service boundary. The UX gap is upstream: detail-page Vue should observe open-Z state and route refund through pre-Z path OR hide button. The choice to expose button + block at submit is a 'reveal then deny' anti-pattern; cashier wasted 30s typing reason.

REASONING-5 Cash Overview source=15 omission: PaymentService for POS V4 codepath writes source=15 (POS enum), but Cash Overview controller buckets by legacy source=1=cash_session_id source resolver. The drift is a Wave T or X refactor side-effect — orders.source enum extended without updating the report aggregator query. Sentinel test could compare sum(cash_movements today) vs Cash Overview KPI total — they should match within €0.01.

REASONING-6 Kiosk category mapping gap: Boisson Seule + Frites Seules show only under Sandwich Cayenne kiosk category, not under their dedicated Boissons/Frites categories. Suggests items.category_id assigned to Sandwich Cayenne (id=1) for legacy POS upsell logic, with kiosk respecting the assignment. Either (a) introduce item↔kiosk_category many-to-many, or (b) reassign these items to their natural category and add upsell_category override for POS. Low priority — kiosk users CAN find items via Sandwich Cayenne, but discovery is poor.

REASONING-7 (POST ADVISOR PROBE) Broker is NOT the problem: lsof :6001 shows node websockets process LISTEN + 5 ESTABLISHED Chrome connections; window.Echo.connector.pusher.connection.state == 'connected' on KDS+POS+OSS tabs. BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher in .env. The actual gap: window.Echo.connector.channels == [] EMPTY on KDS tab. Page connects but never subscribes. Backend dispatches order.created event on private-branch.1 (verified domain_events #298+#299 with channel=['private-branch.1']) — message goes to broker but no listener. CONSEQUENCE: 3 frontend findings (KDS no-show, POS panel stale, Cash Overview src=15) are 3 INDEPENDENT code issues NOT 1 config issue. The verdict 'AMBER with 4 P1 code findings' STANDS post-probe.
